result:
**Not ready to publish. Two problems.**

Claims check:

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "easy to stop and start" | Soft description of the pause/cancel terms. Fine. |
| "you'll love it or it's free" | **Unsupported.** Section 3 names this as an offer we don't have. It is a guarantee. |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted. |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted. |
| "most boxes ship free" | **Unsupported.** We have no data on order sizes, so "most" is an invented figure. It also implies something the shipping policy doesn't say. |

Other checks:
- **Banned words and structures:** none found.
- **Urgency and health claims:** none.
- **Disclosure:** none needed. This is our own page copy.
- **Spelling:** UK, fine.

**Compliant version:**

> Tea you can pause or cancel any time. Subscribers can stop and start whenever they like, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

Sam still needs to approve it before it goes out.
